title: Front-end developer
description: We are looking for a skilled Frontend Developer to join our development team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for building responsive, scalable, and user-friendly web applications using modern frontend technologies. You will work closely with UI/UX designers, backend developers, and product teams to deliver high-quality features and seamless user experiences.
responsibilities:
• Develop responsive and user-friendly web applications.
• Build reusable and maintainable UI components.
• Convert UI/UX designs and wireframes into high-quality frontend code.
• Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs and backend services.
• Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and cross-browser compatibility.
• Identify and fix UI, functional, and performance issues.
• Write clean, reusable, and well-documented code.
• Participate in code reviews and contribute to frontend architecture decisions.
• Collaborate with designers, backend developers, QA, and product teams.
• Stay updated with modern frontend technologies and best practices.
requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
• 2+ years of professional experience in frontend development.
• Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript/TypeScript.
• Hands-on experience with React.js and/or Next.js.
• Good understanding of responsive web design and cross-browser compatibility.
• Experience integrating REST APIs.
• Good understanding of Git and version control.
• Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
• Ability to write clean, maintainable, and reusable code.
preferred_qualifications:
• Experience with Next.js and modern React patterns.
• Experience with Tailwind CSS or similar UI frameworks.
• Familiarity with state management libraries such as Redux or Zustand.
• Experience with frontend testing frameworks such as Jest or React Testing Library.
• Understanding of SEO and web performance optimization.
• Experience with CI/CD and cloud deployment platforms such as Vercel or AWS.
• Familiarity with Figma and design handoff workflows.
benefits:
• Competitive salary based on experience and skills.
• Flexible and collaborative work environment.
• Opportunity to work with modern frontend technologies.
• Learning and professional development opportunities.
• Performance-based growth opportunities.
• Paid leave and standard employee benefits.
• Opportunity to work on scalable, real-world products.

title: MY JOB Title
description: We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our high-performing core engineering team in Pune. In this role, you will lead the architecture, design, and implementation of scalable RESTful APIs and distributed backend microservices. You will work closely with cross-functional product and engineering teams to build robust, secure, and resilient cloud solutions.
responsibilities:
Architect, develop, and maintain production-grade REST APIs and microservices using Node.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL.
- Perform rigorous code reviews, establish engineering best practices, and mentor junior and mid-level engineers.
- Optimize database queries, indexing, and application performance for high-throughput concurrency.
- Design CI/CD containerized deployment pipelines using Docker and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP).
- Collaborate with Product Managers, QA, and UI/UX teams to deliver scalable product features on schedule.
requirements:
Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
- 5+ years of hands-on software development experience building scalable web applications.
- Strong proficiency in Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), and asynchronous programming.
- Deep expertise in relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL, complex SQL queries, and schema design.
- Hands-on experience with RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and security authentication protocols (JWT, OAuth2).
preferred_qualifications:
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms (AWS / GCP / Azure).
- Familiarity with frontend frameworks like React or Next.js.
- Knowledge of Redis caching, message queues, transactional outbox pattern, or Event-Driven Architecture.
- Strong problem-solving skills and experience with Agile/Scrum software development methodologies.
benefits:
Competitive salary and performance-based annual bonuses.
- Comprehensive medical and health insurance coverage for employee and dependents.
- Flexible work hours and generous paid time off (PTO) policy.
- Annual learning & professional development allowance for certifications and conferences.
- Modern office environment with wellness perks and team outings.
